Instead of importing identity, we can define apply and compose_left without needing identity. We can avoid import identity. Instead, apply doesn't need identity. compose_left needs identity to return if no funcs. But we can import identity via a local import inside function, but circular still? We can import from .functoolz inside function compose_left; but that would still cause circular import because when functoolz imports _compose, _compose imports functoolz? Actually _compose imports identity from functoolz at module import time, causing circular. Instead modify _compose to not import identity. We can use a fallback identity defined locally.
